name: Very Simple PayPal Donation Form
author: springthistle

sections.description:
Put a simple PayPal donation form on any post or page with a shortcode. The form has buttons for quick donation amounts, the option to enter your own amount, and the option to choose a one-time or monthly recurring donation.

Use the shortcode [vsdf_donation_form] on any page, and set your PayPal email address, currency, amount buttons and button text under Settings > Donation Form.

External services

This plugin sends your donors to PayPal to complete their donation. When a donor clicks the donate button, the form submits the donation amount, the donation type (one-time or monthly), the currency code, your PayPal email address and your chosen return page URL to paypal.com. Nothing is sent to PayPal until the donor clicks the button.

  • PayPal Terms of Use: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/useragreement-full
  • PayPal Privacy Statement: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full
sections.installation:
1. Install either via the WordPress.org plugin directory, or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Donation Form and enter your PayPal email address.
  4. Use the shortcode [vsdf_donation_form] on any page!
sections.faq:
What if I want a new feature?

Ask in the support forum. I may add it for you.

Can I use a currency other than US dollars?

Yes. Enter the three-letter currency code and the symbol you want displayed in the plugin settings.
sections.changelog:
1.4

  • Security: all settings are now sanitized when saved, and all output is escaped.
  • Fix: removed a stray output-buffer flush that could interfere with other output on the page.
  • The form’s CSS and JavaScript now load only on pages that show the form; the admin CSS and JavaScript load only on the plugin’s settings page.
  • Renamed script and style handles so they cannot collide with other plugins.
  • The currency symbol is now used in the default-amount choices on the settings page and in the form’s validation messages.
  • Fixed the broken logo image, invalid link and label markup on the settings page, and duplicate HTML ids and attributes in the form.
  • Moved the settings page script into its own file and replaced deprecated jQuery calls.
  • Added translation support for visible text.
  • Added uninstall cleanup of the plugin’s saved settings.
  • Updated requirements: WordPress 6.0 and PHP 7.4. Tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.3

  • You can now specify a currency symbol to display on the form.

1.2

  • You can now specify currency.

1.1

  • Consolidated more functionality into classes.
  • Added settings for PayPal Email and Extra CSS.
  • Cleaned up front-end css.

1.0

  • Initial custom build. Functional but not customizable.
